messages:
alex: RC created in CI: rc-lite-v2 (artifact: abcd1234). Release notes drafted. Target prod change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. Requesting ops + QA signoff, and a quick KV warm. @priya @sam @jenna-sheriff
priya: eyeballed changelog, no schema changes. smoke on staging passed for chat and embeddings. kv-warm looked fine. :thumbsup:
sam: QA green. no regressions on main flows. recommend 5% canary for 10m then ramp if stable.
deploy-bot: New release candidate recorded: rc-lite-v2 (sha: abcd1234). To promote run: `/deploy promote rc-lite-v2 --to=prod --canary=5%`
alex: pinning artifact in release registry to avoid auto-rebuilds: `releasectl pin rc-lite-v2 --reason="originate for prod window"`
lina: change window confirmed. oncall for the window is jenna-sheriff. Ops checklist: KV pre-warm, prefix cache, trace headers enabled, rollback playbook at hand.
jenna-sheriff: I'm oncall. Setting abort triggers: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m. Will run live metrics.
sam: quick smoke commands for canary (drop into thread): ```bash
curl -sS https://prod-canary.example.com/health | jq .status
# expect: {"status":"ok"}
```
deploy-bot: Received promotion intent from alex. Starting canary rollout (5%). Updating routing rules and creating 3 canary instances. KV warm task enqueued.
deploy-bot: Canary pods up. KV prefix cache warmed (approx 92% hit after warm). Starting 10m observation window.
jenna-sheriff: initial metrics: error-rate +0.08%, p95 +40ms — within thresholds. continuing observation.
priya: ran quick E2E on canary endpoints, chat flow good, embeddings consistent. recommending ramp to 25% after 10m.
alex: go ahead to ramp to 25% after observation window. execute: `/deploy promote rc-lite-v2 --to=prod --canary=25% --auto-ramp 10m`
deploy-bot: Starting ramp to 25%. Auto-ramp scheduled: hold 10m at 25% then continue to 100% if no abort. Estimated full promotion in ~35m.
jenna-sheriff: watching dashboards. no abort conditions met so far. continuing. :thumbsup: 
sam: if we see small error blips, prefer to hold and investigate rather than immediate rollback. have logs collected and a quick revert command ready.
alex: rollback command for reference: `deployctl rollback --release=prev-stable --reason="auto"` — ops has creds.
deploy-bot: Auto-ramp completed, promoting to 100% now. Draining canary nodes into main fleet.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% completed at 2024-04-16T15:12:03Z. All instances reporting healthy. Release notes: minor KV refresh improvement and embedding batching tweak.
jenna-sheriff: post-promote check: traces look healthy, no sustained error increases. Good to close.
priya: will post final release note to #release-notes in 5m. thanks team. :party-parrot:
alex: excellent — closing origination thread. saved rollout artifacts to release registry and pinned final prod artifact.
